goal: Iske baad aap bata sakte hain ke p + 1, p++ aur p - q kahan pahunchte hain, arr[i] ki jagah *(p + i) use kar sakte hain, pointers ko compare kar sakte hain, aur woh arithmetic bata sakte hain jo allowed NAHI hai.
warmup: Cinema mein seats ki ek row ka tasawwur karein, har seat ki chaurai ek jaisi. Agar aap seat 5 par hain aur 3 seats daayein taraf jaate hain, to aap centimetres mein nahi napte. Aap bas seats ginte hain: ab aap seat 8 par hain. Pointer bhi aisa hi karta hai. p + 3 ka matlab hai teen ELEMENTS aage jao, aur computer bytes ka hisab khud nikal leta hai: 3 ints = 12 bytes.
definition: Pointer arithmetic ka matlab hai pointer mein poore numbers jama ya minus karna. 1 jama karne se 1 byte nahi barhta. Pointer apni hi type ke agle element par chala jata hai, yani sizeof(type) bytes jama hote hain. Hamare computers par int * ke liye p + 1, 4 bytes aage hota hai. Array ka naam pehle element ka address hota hai, is liye int *p = arr; ke liye *(p + i) aur arr[i] ek hi cheez hain.
howItWorks: Memory picture chalayein. Array ke elements 4 bytes ke faasle par hain, is liye addresses 0x1000, 0x1004, 0x1008 aur isi tarah chalte hain. Rule yeh hai: p + n ka address p + n x sizeof(type) hota hai. Agar p ek int * hai jo 1000 par hai, to p + 1 hai 1004, p + 3 hai 1012, p++ se p khud 1004 ban jata hai, aur p-- usay wapas le jata hai. p + 1 aur p++ ka farq dekhein (p + 1 naya address deta hai, p wahin rehta hai; p++ p ko badal deta hai). Ek hi array ke do pointers ko minus kiya ja sakta hai: q - p un ke darmiyan elements ki ginti deta hai (bytes nahi). Unhein == != < > <= >= se compare bhi kiya ja sakta hai. Jo allowed NAHI hai: do pointers ko jama karna, pointer ko multiply ya divide karna, aur alag types ya alag arrays ke pointers ko minus karna. Aakhir mein ek jaal: *p++ ka matlab hai value lo, phir pointer aage barhao (++ p ka hai). (*p)++ ka matlab hai jis value par p point kar raha hai usay barhao, aur p wahin rehta hai. Aur array ke andar rahein: pointer ko aakhri element se aage le ja kar wahan * use karne se aisi memory parhi jati hai jo aap ki nahi hai.
